items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: He put Pete Clark in the place of the clarinet player that he had. And Rostelle Reese, a trumpet player, he taken the place of Clarence Brereton. And we started out again, we went to Milwaukee -- and that was the personnel of the band in Milwaukee.

ctx.x: Who was the trumpet player. Do you know?
Yeah, it was Clarence Brereton. He's the one that couldn't stand up.
